name: 炎黄武魂public-final-2016-12-08
group_note: 炎黄武魂public-final-2016-12-08 -- a Doing-lineage build (master.lpc's header credits 'ES II mudlib... updated by Doing Lu for hell (2K), modified by Linux@lxtx for yh 2003.3'), in-game titled《武林群侠传》之炎黄武魂. Surname+given-name registration (get_surname/get_name) with dual admin+login passwords, a 5-option character-type menu (猛士/智慧/耐力/敏捷/均衡) instead of a gift-stat roll, and no email step. WASM pass fixed: (1) classic §8.1 GBK byte-range is_chinese() (parity-gated 176-247/161-254 byte check) rewritten to a per-codepoint 0x4e00-0x9fff loop over every character (not just the first). (2) Three independent byte-doubled length-bound bugs from the same §8.1 lineage, all halved to match this driver's per-codepoint string indexing: check_legal_name()'s minimum bound (strlen<2 -> strlen<1) and its maxlen bound (maxlen -> maxlen/2), the combined surname+name minimum in get_name() (strlen(fname)<4 -> <2), and named.lpc's invalid_new_name() sliding-window near-name dedup checks (minimum 2->1, window slices name[i..i+3]/name[i..i+5] -> name[i..i+1]/name[i..i+2], loop bound l-4 -> l-2, gate i+6<=l -> i+3<=l) -- without these, a single-character surname like 张 was rejected as 'too long' and any two-character full name was rejected as 'too short'. (3) master.lpc's valid_read()/valid_write() (unusually at adm/single/master.lpc, not the typical adm/obj/master.lpc) were missing the standard 'user == this_object()' short-circuit before delegating to SECURITY_D -- added to both, fixing the silent new()-registration-hang failure mode. (4) versiond.lpc's in_server() called get_config(__MUD_PORT__) + VERSION_PORT expecting an int but the WASM driver's get_config(__MUD_PORT__) didn't resolve to the expected type here, producing a string-concatenated port ('12') and a 'Bad argument 2 to socket_bind()' crash at every boot; per AGENTS.md §7.52 (matching the hell/hell-family precedent for this same versiond.lpc lineage almost verbatim), gutted all 13 socket-touching functions (in_server, connect_server, clear_syn_info's socket_close loop, send_command, send_client_pending_msg, syn_finish's socket_close, in_listen_callback, in_write_callback, in_close_callback, cmd_close, send_pending_msg, send_result, remove_connection's socket_close) to no-ops/notify_fail, leaving the surrounding version-tracking logic (which doesn't touch sockets) intact. (5) §7.50 is_killing(object) vs is_killing(string id) type mismatch fixed across 15 call sites (kungfu/skill/*.lpc's 10 hits, clone/user/user.lpc, clone/lonely/sheying.lpc, d/city/npc/guidao.lpc, cmds/std/surrender.lpc, cmds/std/ansuan.lpc) via the standard ->query("id") wrapper. adm/daemons/ftpd.lpc and adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc are both dormant (commented out of adm/etc/preload, no runtime callers outside their own network/ subdir) and were left untouched. Admin seeded: wlqxztest (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (wiz_levels tops out at (admin); wizlist lookup is by ID string alone, so admin status shows immediately on a freshly-registered character with no separate save/relogin step needed). Registration verified end-to-end multiple times: English id -> y (confirm new character) -> surname -> given name -> admin password + confirm -> login password + confirm -> character-type menu (1-5, used 5) -> gender (m/f) -> enters 世外桃源, full flow clean. Admin permission confirmed via '目前权限：(admin)'. score requiring a separate in-game '出生' step before it reports data is an intentional game-design gate, not a bug, and was left alone. LPC formatter run across all 10751 .lpc files (10715 written, 6 pre-existing errors on messy legacy code, 30 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates, no CJK-respacing/broken-escape hits. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).
